description:
Project Reactor CallAdapterFactory implementations for REST-in-peace -
		Mono<T> and Flux<T> return-type support, including a
		backpressure-aware Flux<T> over @Paginated methods.
		See docs/design/reactor-call-adapter.md in the parent repository for
		the full design and rollout plan. A sibling reactor module of core/
		(not a dependent of it in the reactor sense - it resolves core the
		same way a real downstream consumer would, as an ordinary Maven
		dependency), sharing core's version and release cadence via their
		common parent. Targets Java 8, matching core, since this module adds
		no framework requirement of its own beyond reactor-core itself
		(unlike rest-in-peace-spring-boot-starter, which needs Java 17+ for
		Spring Boot 4.x).
